state.paragraph: On July 11, 2013, CSC/Pamplona entered into a confidentiality and standstill agreement with Mac-Gray and were provided with an informational package for the purpose of providing CSC/Pamplona with data to formulate a preliminary indication of interest.

ledger_rows.Note: Denied Moab's request to partner exclusively with CSC/Pamplona for a rollover at this stage, permitting later-stage discussions so Moab's equity could be available to other bidders.
Signed confidentiality and standstill agreement and received an informational package to formulate a preliminary indication of interest.
Preliminary indication at the round-1 due date; no substantive diligence access yet (management meetings began in August).

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
